meta.title: eventmem memory
meta.description: Local-first event memory with recall, seven tools, turn-end extraction and the memory console under Plugins in the sidebar. This bundle is only a client: install and start the eventmem daemon separately. The default is a local daemon at 127.0.0.1 with no SSH; remote sharing is opt-in. The daemon can require a bearer token. Turn-end extraction sends a redacted excerpt to the host's configured model, which may be remote. If the daemon is unreachable, automatic memory is skipped rather than blocking the turn.
